basic_info.description: Welcome to this elegantly appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom, end unit, urban retreat in The Towers, one of South Beach's most coveted addresses. This sophisticated residence boasts breathtaking water views, showcasing the Bay Bridge and East Bay Hills from the primary bedroom and living areas, while offering stunning downtown skyline views from the kitchen, living room, and second bedroom. A highlight of this home is the expansive private balcony, providing the perfect space to unwind while taking in panoramic views of the marina, downtown, and Sutro Tower, all complemented by the refreshing Bay breeze. Designed to maximize natural light, the condo features floor-to-ceiling windows, custom-designed California Closets, and a thoughtful split-bedroom layout for optimal privacy. Additional conveniences include an in-unit washer/dryer, 1-car parking, and extra storage space. Residents of The Towers enjoy resort-style amenities, including a fitness center, sauna, conference room, business center, and an entertainment lounge with a fully-equipped kitchen. Just one block from the waterfront, this exceptional location offers easy access to world-class dining, entertainment, parks, and recreational activities, along with seamless connectivity to freeways and public transportation.
